title: Juicy Buttery Syrian V Sterbottensost Cheese Flatbread
description: A kid-friendly Syrian dish featuring V Sterbottensost cheese, this flatbread is buttery, aerated, and FODMAP-friendly, served in a scallop shell vessel.

ingredients.name: V Sterbottensost cheese
ingredients.notes: ensure low-lactose or lactose-free for FODMAP diet

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, salt, and yeast.
Gradually add warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a large rectangle.
Brush the melted butter evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the shredded V Sterbottensost cheese over the butter.
Fold the dough over the cheese to form a triangle or use a scallop shell mold to shape the flatbread.
Place the flatbread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
